description: Planning-stage evaluation suite. Each task drives the agent through setup then asks for a parameter sweep. Covers volume-fraction (NVT), pressure (NPT), per-component shape parameters, relative volume fraction, two-axis sweeps, and an adversarial NVT+pressure mismatch. Build the 'full' skill variant before running: python eval/build_skill_variant.py --variant-id full

user_profiles.description: Describes the workflow in natural language and expects the agent to structure the process.
Uses domain-specific language and expects concise workflow handling with minimal handholding.
Uses incomplete, slightly inconsistent, or poorly phrased requests to test robustness.
